messages.subject: annotation logticks outside axes?
parts:
When using the annotation_logticks() it generates tick marks on the inside of the axes.  Using the sides="trbl" I can choose whether they are displayed on the top, right, bottom, or left axes, but all the time they are always on the inside. 

I'm working with a journal that is insisting that these logticks appear on the outside of the axes (like the major tick marks).  Any suggestions?

James
